text:
maria: Hey team — Fjord customer (acct: fjord-llc) private VPC cutover is slated for Thu 2025-08-14 02:00-03:30 UTC. Need final go/no-go by 01:30 UTC. I'll be primary on-call for the window. Can people ack and call out smoke owners?

 tariq: ack. I'll handle DB migrations + smoke. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fjord-cutover. Plan to test read-only replicas first, then promote. Will post verification logs here.

 josh: ack. I'll own app-plane canary and the rollback script is at https://gist.github.com/josh/rollback-fjord. Note: watch for 503 spike >2% over 5m, and p99 token latency.

 olivia: I'll update the ACL whitelist and rotate customer VPN certs by 01:00 UTC. Will validate connectivity from customer test VM and report.

 sam: Quick q — do we have a Dedicated fallback endpoint if private nodes fail? What's the expected p95 latency if we route there?

 maria: Yes — fallback is dedicated:redwood-d-1. Typical p95 ~120ms, cold-starts may be higher. Automated failover is configured as a safety, but we'll prefer manual switch for the first 30m of cutover unless customer requests immediate failover.

 deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: fjord-cutover v2 at 2025-08-14T02:00:00Z by maria. CI: passing. Docker image: redwood/fjord:v2.0.1

 tariq: Preflight checklist done:
 - DB snapshot taken
 - migrations staged (apply in dry-run)
 - smoke script uploaded

 Smoke commands I will run (posting here so lasers can copy):
 ```
 # health check
 curl -sS https://fjord.internal/health | jq .status
 # simple inference test
 python tools/smoke.py --endpoint https://fjord.internal/generate --prompt 'hello' --tokens 16
 ```

 olivia: ACLs updated and validated from customer IPs. SSH tunnel test succeeds from 198.51.100.22 -> 198.51.100.1 (customer test VM).

 josh: I'll start a 5% canary at 02:05 UTC and post results. Need one more quick PR review for the canary config (PR #1234) — @sam can you glance?

 sam: reviewed and approved PR #1234. +1

 maria: Final reminder on rollback plans:
 - Plan A: rollback helm release to fjord:v1.9 (fast)
 - Plan B: revert routing to dedicated:redwood-d-1 and hold
 Abort criteria: >15m of degraded requests or error rate >5% sustained for 10m. If we hit abort, we'll call a hard rollback and notify customer.

 tariq: Understood. I'll post smoke outputs within 15m of cutover start.

 olivia: ack. :party_parrot:
